findings.message: Sub-process "Review items" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to catch unhandled errors thrown inside the sub-process.

findings.message: User task "Assess claim" has no timer boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add a timer boundary to enforce an SLA and prevent tasks from waiting indefinitely.

findings.message: "Check for fraud" (serviceTask) has no zeebe:taskDefinition type.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: "Pay out claim" (serviceTask) has no zeebe:taskDefinition type.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: Must have either one 'zeebe:publishMessage' or one 'zeebe:taskDefinition' extension element
findings.suggestion: Add a zeebe:publishMessage to the message event definition, or a zeebe:taskDefinition to the event.

findings.message: Must have either one 'zeebe:script' or one 'zeebe:taskDefinition' extension element
findings.suggestion: Give the script task one zeebe:script or one zeebe:taskDefinition.

findings.message: Must have exactly one 'zeebe:loopCharacteristics' extension element
findings.suggestion: Add a single zeebe:loopCharacteristics element to the multi-instance loop.
